stories.title: Heart, hope and a steely determination: Dolly Parton's musical legacy
stories.summary: BBC music correspondent Mark Savage looks back on the legacy of the "irreplaceable" late singer.

stories.title: Door was locked at Pakistan hospital where fire killed 14 babies, witnesses say
stories.summary: A hospital official told the BBC that the door to the ward was not locked, but manned with security guards, to protect the babies.

stories.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
stories.summary: The latest escalation in an ongoing trade war between the US and Canada will see new levies on goods from steel to furniture, fresh tuna and makeup.

stories.title: Radiation link in flight attendant's breast cancer, French court finds
stories.summary: Former Air France stewardess Sophie Lainault has had her cancer recognised as an occupational disease.

stories.title: Far-right Israeli lawmaker damages Palestinian memorial with sledgehammer
stories.summary: Zvi Sukkot's actions have drawn widespread condemnation, including from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

stories.title: Libyan who was cleared after Lockerbie bombing trial dies aged 70
stories.summary: A Facebook post by Libyan Airlines announced the death of Al Amin Khalifah Fhimah and expressed the company's condolences to his family.

stories.title: Yellow warnings remain in force as rain and thunderstorms hit parts of UK
stories.summary: Yellow warnings updated as torrential downpours affect parts of England and Wales, delivering some of the wettest weather in several weeks.

stories.title: 'Magical' and rare barn owl has bumper breeding season
stories.summary: Ten chicks have been successfully reared by two breeding pairs at secret sites across Fermanagh.

stories.title: Fires still burn in charred landscape as focus turns to wildfire prevention
stories.summary: The RSPB is considering measures it can take to improve resilience in the wake of a five-week long fire in the Cairngorms.

stories.title: Meta agrees to pay up to $17.1bn to settle social media case
stories.summary: The deal has been reached during a California federal court trial over claims brought by 29 states.

stories.title: AI gold rush draws crypto firms away from Bitcoin
stories.summary: The price of Bitcoin has risen in August but is still far below its peak almost a year ago - and companies are refitting their mines.

stories.title: Songs created by AI banned from Australia's music charts
stories.summary: The move comes weeks after a DJ admitted using AI to remix a Madonna song that topped the Australian charts.
